title: NIT Silchar Notification 2026 - Apply for 02 Project Intern Posts
description: The National Institute of Technology Silchar (NIT Silchar) has issued the official notification for the recruitment of 02 Project Intern positions. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech or M.E/ M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering can grab this chance and apply for the NIT Silchar Notification 2026 . This post includes the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply before...
